sub_theme: People Who Help Us at School

lessons.title: Who Helps Us at School?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to name an adult at school who helps them and how.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss who greeted them at the school gate this morning.
lessons.main_activity: Introduce photos of key school staff (office, kitchen, midday supervisor); children discuss how each person helps.
key_questions: How does the office help us?

differentiation.extension: Explain how 4+ roles help the school run

lessons.assessment_notes: Note awareness of school community roles — evidence for PSED.3.
lessons.plenary: Class thank-you cheer for school helpers.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family about someone who helped you at school today.

lessons.title: Thank You Messages for School Helpers
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to compose a simple thank-you message in a full sentence.
lessons.starter_activity: Adult models a thank-you sentence.
lessons.main_activity: Children compose (verbally, adult scribes) a thank-you sentence for a chosen school helper.
key_questions: What will you say to them?

differentiation.extension: Add a reason within the sentence

lessons.assessment_notes: Note sentence construction — evidence for CL.2.
lessons.plenary: Share thank-you messages with the group.
lessons.home_link: Say thank you to someone who helps you at home.

lessons.title: Fire Safety Movement: Stop, Drop, and Crawl
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform basic fire-safety movements (crawling low, moving calmly).
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what a firefighter does.
lessons.main_activity: Practise crawling low under a 'smoke' (rope/fabric) line and walking calmly to a safe 'exit' point.
resources_needed: Rope/fabric for smoke line, floor markers
key_questions: Why do we crawl low in smoke?
How do we move safely in an emergency?

differentiation.extension: Lead a partner through the safety actions

lessons.assessment_notes: Note gross motor control and safety understanding — evidence for PD.1.
lessons.plenary: Recap the fire safety steps learned.
lessons.home_link: Talk about your family's fire safety plan/exit at home.

lessons.title: Phonics: Introducing 'c/k'
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to say the sound 'c' and blend words (cat, cop, kid).
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sounds learned so far.
lessons.main_activity: Introduce 'c' sound/action; blend new CVC words.
lessons.assessment_notes: Update phonics tracker for 'c'.
lessons.plenary: Sing all 11 sounds learned.
lessons.home_link: Practise blending cat, cop, kid.

lessons.title: Counting School Staff and Uniforms
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to count and compare quantities of items linked to different school helper roles.
lessons.starter_activity: Count adults visible in the classroom.
lessons.main_activity: Count sets of role-related items (e.g. chef hats, first aid items) and compare quantities.
lessons.assessment_notes: Record counting accuracy — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Class total count recap.
lessons.home_link: Count uniforms/tools linked to a job you know at home.

lessons.title: Emergency Services Introduction
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to name the three main emergency services and their role.
lessons.starter_activity: Play emergency vehicle sounds and guess which service.
lessons.main_activity: Introduce police, fire service, and ambulance; discuss what each does and when we call them.
key_questions: Who do we call if there's a fire?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note recall of community helper roles — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap all three emergency services.
lessons.home_link: Talk about when you might need to call for help.

lessons.title: Making a Police/Firefighter Hat
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to construct and decorate a simple role-play hat.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at real/picture examples of service hats.
lessons.main_activity: Children make and decorate a paper hat representing a chosen helper role.
key_questions: Which helper hat are you making?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe fine motor and creative choice — evidence for EAD.1.
lessons.plenary: Wear hats and parade around the classroom.
lessons.home_link: Make a simple hat/costume for pretend play at home.

lessons.title: Who Can I Ask for Help?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to identify a trusted adult to ask for help in different situations.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what to do if you feel worried at school.
lessons.main_activity: Match simple scenario cards (feeling unwell, lost toy, feeling sad) to the right school helper to ask.
key_questions: Who would you ask if you felt poorly?
Who helps if you feel sad?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note understanding of safe help-seeking — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Recap trusted adults at school.
lessons.home_link: Talk about who you can ask for help at home and school.

lessons.title: 999 Call Role-Play Listening
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to listen to and recall key information in a simple emergency scenario.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what 999 is for.
lessons.main_activity: Role-play a simple pretend 999 call, practising giving/listening for key information (what happened, where).
key_questions: What information does the operator need?

differentiation.support: Adult models the call, child repeats key info
differentiation.extension: Child role-plays both caller and operator

lessons.assessment_notes: Note listening and information recall — evidence for CL.1.
lessons.plenary: Recap what to say in an emergency.
lessons.home_link: Learn your home address/a trusted phone number with an adult.

lessons.title: Firefighter Obstacle Course
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to complete an obstacle course themed around a firefighter's job.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what firefighters do physically (climbing, carrying hoses).
lessons.main_activity: Complete a themed obstacle course: crawl through a tunnel, climb over a soft obstacle, carry a 'hose' (rope) to a target.
key_questions: How did firefighters need to be strong?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note strength/coordination progress — evidence for PD.1.
lessons.plenary: Cool down; discuss firefighter skills needed.
lessons.home_link: Set up a simple obstacle course at home.

lessons.title: Story Time: 'Whatever Next!' or a Firefighter/Police Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to sequence the main events of the story.
lessons.starter_activity: Predict from the cover.
lessons.main_activity: Read a story about a helper role, then sequence 3-4 picture cards of key events.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note sequencing comprehension — evidence for LIT.1.
lessons.plenary: Retell the story as a class using the sequenced cards.
lessons.home_link: Retell today's story to someone at home.

lessons.title: Shapes on Uniforms and Badges
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to identify 2D shapes found on helper badges/uniforms.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at example badges (police star, first aid cross).
lessons.main_activity: Design a badge for a helper role using given 2D shapes, naming each shape used.
key_questions: How many sides does it have?

differentiation.extension: Combine 4+ shapes and name them all

lessons.assessment_notes: Note shape recognition and application — evidence for MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Display badges designed.
lessons.home_link: Look for shapes on badges/logos at home.

lessons.title: Doctors and Nurses
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how doctors/nurses help us stay healthy.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss a time someone visited a doctor.
lessons.main_activity: Role-play simple doctor's check-up scenario using props (stethoscope, bandages), discussing how doctors/nurses help.
key_questions: How do they help us feel better?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note understanding of healthcare helper roles — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap how doctors/nurses help us.
lessons.home_link: Talk about a time a doctor/nurse helped your family.

lessons.title: Role-Play: Hospital Corner
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to engage in imaginative role-play as a doctor/nurse/patient.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap Tuesday's doctor discussion.
lessons.main_activity: Free role-play in a hospital-themed corner with dolls as patients, using imaginative caring language.
key_questions: How will you help them feel better?

differentiation.extension: Child extends the scenario with own ideas

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe imaginative and caring language — evidence for EAD.2/PSED.3.
lessons.plenary: Share who was 'treated' in the hospital corner today.
lessons.home_link: Play a pretend doctor game at home.

lessons.title: Following School Safety Rules
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to explain why a school safety rule keeps us safe.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap classroom rules from Week 1.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss school-specific safety rules (walking in corridors, holding the rail on stairs) and why they matter.
key_questions: Why do we walk in the corridor?
What could happen if we don't follow this rule?

differentiation.support: Adult gives the reason, child repeats

lessons.assessment_notes: Note safety reasoning — evidence for PSED.2.
lessons.plenary: Practise walking safely in a line to another area.
lessons.home_link: Talk about safety rules at home.

lessons.title: Visitor Talk: Listening to a School Helper
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to listen attentively to a visitor and ask a simple question.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what makes a good listener (recap Week 1).
lessons.main_activity: (If possible) a school staff member visits to talk about their job; children listen and ask a prepared question. If no visitor available, watch/discuss a video or photo interview instead.
key_questions: What did you learn about their job?

differentiation.support: Adult asks the question on child's behalf
differentiation.extension: Child asks their own follow-up question

lessons.assessment_notes: Note listening attention and question-forming — evidence for CL.1.
lessons.plenary: Thank the visitor/recap the video learning.
lessons.home_link: Ask a family member about their job.

lessons.title: Bandaging Practice (Fine Motor)
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to wrap a soft bandage around an object with some control.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at how a bandage is applied (picture/demo).
lessons.main_activity: Children practise wrapping soft fabric/bandage strips around a teddy's arm or a cardboard tube.
key_questions: How does the teddy feel now?

differentiation.support: Adult starts the wrap, child continues
differentiation.extension: Wrap independently and secure the end

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe fine motor control and hand-eye coordination — evidence for PD.2.
lessons.plenary: Show off bandaged teddies.
lessons.home_link: Practise wrapping/rolling something at home (e.g. ribbon, string).

lessons.title: Phonics: Introducing 'e'
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to say the sound 'e' and blend words (pet, ten, net).
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sounds learned so far.
lessons.main_activity: Introduce 'e' sound/action; blend new CVC words.
lessons.assessment_notes: Update phonics tracker for 'e'.
lessons.plenary: Sing all 12 sounds learned.
lessons.home_link: Practise blending pet, ten, net.

lessons.title: Time Vocabulary: A Helper's Day
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to sequence parts of a helper's day using time vocabulary.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what children do in the morning vs afternoon.
lessons.main_activity: Sequence picture cards showing a school helper's day (arrive, work, lunch, home) using time vocabulary.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note early time-sequencing understanding — evidence for MATHS.1/UTW.1.
lessons.plenary: Recap the school day sequence together.
lessons.home_link: Talk about your own daily routine and its order.

lessons.title: The School Kitchen and Chef
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how the school chef helps the school community.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what children had for lunch today.
lessons.main_activity: (If possible) visit/discuss the school kitchen; children discuss how the chef plans and cooks meals for everyone.

differentiation.extension: Explain the process from planning to serving

lessons.assessment_notes: Note appreciation of school community roles — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Say thank you to the school kitchen staff (card or verbally).
lessons.home_link: Help plan or cook a meal with a family member.

lessons.title: Chef's Hat and Menu Craft
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to construct a chef's hat and design a simple menu.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at real chef hat examples.
lessons.main_activity: Children make a paper chef's hat and design a simple menu drawing for a pretend restaurant.
resources_needed: Paper hat template, menu template, crayons
key_questions: How did you make your hat?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe creative design and fine motor skill — evidence for EAD.1.
lessons.plenary: Parade chef hats and share menus.
lessons.home_link: Help design a real or pretend menu at home.

lessons.title: Being a Helper Ourselves
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to take on a classroom helper job responsibly.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss classroom jobs (line leader, register helper).
lessons.main_activity: Assign and practise simple classroom helper jobs; discuss why each job matters.
key_questions: What job did you do today?

differentiation.extension: Explain the job's importance to the class

lessons.assessment_notes: Note sense of responsibility — evidence for PSED.2/PSED.3.
lessons.plenary: Thank all classroom helpers today.
lessons.home_link: Take on a helper job at home this week.

lessons.title: Explaining a Helper's Job
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to explain what a chosen helper does using full sentences.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's helper roles learned.
lessons.main_activity: Children choose a helper role and explain their job to a partner in full sentences.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note explanatory language — evidence for CL.2.
lessons.plenary: Share explanations with the group.
lessons.home_link: Explain a job to your family in full sentences.

lessons.title: Police Chase Game (Running and Dodging)
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to run and change direction with control during a game.
lessons.starter_activity: Warm-up jogging on the spot.
lessons.main_activity: Play a 'police and robbers' style tag game practising running, dodging, and changing direction safely.
key_questions: How do you dodge a chaser?
How did you change direction quickly?

differentiation.extension: Add rules like freeze tag or team version

lessons.assessment_notes: Note agility and spatial awareness — evidence for PD.1.
lessons.plenary: Cool down; discuss the game's rules and fairness.
lessons.home_link: Play a running/chasing game safely outside.

lessons.title: Writing a Helper Label Book
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write a simple label for a helper picture.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sounds learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Children create a page for a class 'Helpers' book, drawing a helper and attempting to write their job title.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note writing progress — evidence for LIT.3.
lessons.plenary: Compile and read the class Helpers book.
lessons.home_link: Draw and label a helper you know at home.

lessons.title: Number Recognition: Emergency Numbers
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recognise and say the numerals 9-9-9 and other key numbers.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap numeral recognition 1-10.
lessons.main_activity: Focus on recognising numeral 9 and practising saying '999'; also recap other numerals in a matching game.

differentiation.support: Focus on numbers 1-5 with a light touch on 9
differentiation.extension: Recognise numerals to 10 and explain why 999 matters

lessons.assessment_notes: Record numeral recognition — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of the emergency number.
lessons.home_link: Practise recognising numbers on a phone/clock at home.

lessons.title: Helpers in the Wider Community
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to name a helper role beyond the school (postal worker, bin collector, librarian).
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss who delivers post/collects bins at home.
lessons.main_activity: Introduce wider community helper roles with picture cards, discussing how each helps our community.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note broadened understanding of community roles — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap all community helpers learned this week.
lessons.home_link: Notice a community helper on your way home today.

lessons.title: Helper Role-Play Carousel
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to move between imaginative role-play scenarios representing different helpers.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all helper roles explored this week.
lessons.main_activity: Rotate through mini role-play stations (police, doctor, chef, firefighter) trying each imaginative scenario briefly.
resources_needed: Props from the week's role-play activities
key_questions: Which helper did you enjoy being most?
What did you do in this role?

differentiation.extension: Child narrates and extends each scenario

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe imaginative engagement across roles — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Share favourite role played today.
lessons.home_link: Act out your favourite helper role for family.

lessons.title: Thank You to Our School Helpers
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to express gratitude to school helpers as a group.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's learning about helpers.
lessons.main_activity: Deliver thank-you cards/messages made earlier in the week to real school helpers (office, kitchen, midday staff).

differentiation.extension: Child says the thank-you message aloud independently

lessons.assessment_notes: Note gratitude expression — evidence for PSED.3.
lessons.plenary: Reflect on how it felt to say thank you.
lessons.home_link: Thank a helper in your community this weekend.

lessons.title: Helpers Quiz Game
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer recall questions about helper roles learned this week.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's key vocabulary.
lessons.main_activity: Quiz-style game asking questions about helper roles (school and community) from the week.
key_questions: Who helps us if there's a fire?
lessons.assessment_notes: Assess recall and listening comprehension — evidence for CL.1.
lessons.plenary: Team points tally, celebrate together.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on helper roles learned this week.

lessons.title: Helpers Sports Challenge
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to combine running, carrying, and obstacle skills in a themed challenge.
lessons.starter_activity: Warm-up stretches recapping the week's PD vocabulary.
lessons.main_activity: Combined 'rescue mission' obstacle challenge using skills practised this week (crawl, carry, run, aim).
resources_needed: Obstacle course resources from the week
key_questions: What helper skill did you use here?
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise week 6 PD progress — evidence for PD.1/PD.2.
lessons.plenary: Cool down and celebrate completing the challenge.
lessons.home_link: Set up a rescue-mission obstacle course at home.

lessons.title: Phonics Review: All 12 Sounds
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read CVC words and simple sentences using all sounds learned so far.
lessons.starter_activity: Quick-fire flashcard review of all 12 sounds.
lessons.main_activity: Phonics stations: word-building, CVC reading cards, simple sentence reading (e.g. 'a cat can nap').
key_questions: Can you build and read this word?
lessons.assessment_notes: Finalise week 6 phonics tracker.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate all sounds learned with a reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading simple sentences over the weekend.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Number, Shape, and Time
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply number recognition, shape, and time-sequencing skills learned this week.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's maths vocabulary.
lessons.main_activity: Rotate through 3 stations: numeral recognition, badge shape design recap, daily routine sequencing.
key_questions: What happens next in the routine?
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise week 6 maths observations.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all three skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising numbers and shapes over the weekend.

lessons.title: Our Helpers Recap Display
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise the range of helpers learned about this week.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all helper roles covered this week.
lessons.main_activity: Contribute to a large class display mapping all helpers learned about (school and community) and their roles.
key_questions: Which helper did you find most interesting?
What have we learned about helpers?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's learning — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Unveil and admire the finished 'Our Helpers' display.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about helpers with your family.

lessons.title: Helpers Celebration Performance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform a short imaginative scene representing a helper role confidently.
lessons.starter_activity: Choose a favourite helper role from the week to perform.
lessons.main_activity: Small groups perform a short imaginative scene (e.g. firefighter rescue, doctor's check-up) for the class.
key_questions: What was your favourite part of this week?
How did it feel to perform?

differentiation.extension: Lead or narrate part of the scene

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe confidence and imaginative performance — evidence for EAD.2/PSED.3.
lessons.plenary: Round of applause; recap the week's helper learning.
lessons.home_link: Perform your favourite helper scene for family this weekend.
